Rogue is designed to be immune to almost all known toxins, can submerge in strong acid unaffected, and is able to withstand a vacuum on his bare skin.

This film is a visual tribute to the silent strength of a man who chooses the wilderness over comfort, showcasing the fragile balance between Alpine tradition and a rapidly changing world.

Boasting rich knowledge for success as a comedian, this "ideal" Sahara begins meddling with the real Sahara's life.

Xiao Bei stumbled through the "12 things not to do after falling out of love": transform yourself, pretend to be rational, and deal with all kinds of people from the opposite sex... However, can this long list of tips for a lovelorn really lead her out of her heartbreak?

1610337.title: Artichoke
1610337.overview: Held captive in a violent relationship, Cynara discovers a phoropter that opens a portal to another world. In a terrifying cat-and-mouse chase between realities, Cynara finally comes face to face with her oppressor and must decide what she’s willing to destroy in order to survive.

She will be the first to break Pasha's feelings, turning his life into complete madness.

1624609.title: Absolution

1628065.title: Seven Days of Happiness

Life goes on as usual in a remote Yakut village until Prokopiy's cheerful sister, Aiyyna, arrives next door. She gives him warmth, attention, and a sense of "normality," and a simple, pure friendship blossoms between them, which becomes a revelation for the boy. Aiyyna leads him out of his locked room, takes him on a sleigh ride to a party, and for the first time makes him feel part of the outside world. But the closer Prokopiy gets to freedom, the more conflicts he has with his mother, who fears losing control and may not be able to protect her son from the pain society can inflict on him. A touching, harsh, and poetic coming-of-age story about a man who emerges from the safety of a locked world to an ambiguous freedom.

Everyone will have to answer the question of why they dance — for the sake of popularity or at the call of their hearts.

Now he must pull off one final deal to stay alive — a deal far beyond anything he can fake.

There, he must confront a local reality that clashes with his aspirations and ideals, placing him at a crossroads between avoiding confrontation within an oppressive political context and pursuing personal and artistic freedom.

1653281.overview: Far from home, a young Burmese man struggles to escape the weight of a brutal and unforgiving military coup, threatening both his nation’s freedom and its very survival. Now, in Australia and unable to return home, he’s doing everything he can to stay connected to his people.

1655265.title: El mágico cerebro de un hombre atormentado

What starts as a desperate chase for a girl becomes a tough journey inward--where he learns the hardest person to understand isn't someone else, but himself.

1686945.title: I Am the Prize

1687009.title: Kaya

1687841.title: Return to My Blue

1688865.title: Vittorio De Sica: Staging Life

Through a new access to his family, rare archives and testimonies of contemporary artists and filmmakers from the entire world, the ilm retraces his life, his work and legacy. An intimate portrait of an author able to transform the observation of the real in an universal emotion and reveals the modernity of a gaze which keeps on illuminating cinema and our way of seeing the world.

1688993.title: Sugar
1688993.overview: Oscar, a young sex worker, spends the night with an older client who introduces him to GHB and promises care. As the drug takes hold, reality fractures and past and present collide — until the night turns dangerous.

1692385.title: Borrowed Ragtime

1694049.title: In Salita

But when Ale shows up with his sarcastic fifteen-year-old sister Viola, everything changes. No luxury hotel, no excess: just camping tents, mountain trails, and a lot of (emotional) endurance. Alternating between present and flashback, between jokes and internal breakdowns, the protagonists discover that growing up is scary, but doing it together might just make it easier.

1694305.title: Faceless: Retribution

Their increasingly dysfunctional arrangement spirals into a dark comedy about celebrity, loneliness, obsession, and fandom.

Instead of luxurious surroundings, they end up in a mysterious jungle commune where nothing is as it seems.

1701729.title: Pamanang Pamangan

1702625.title: Another Day in the Metal Box

1704673.title: The Intimacy Coordinator

1707105.title: Kings County

1711009.title: Crush

Like a fairy godmother, Solange decides to introduce Juliette to a former colleague. Dimitri is handsome and very charismatic. But could Solange be betraying her own desires by offering him to Juliette?

1711393.title: Clear conscience
1711393.overview: An extremely honest forest ranger fights for the trust to the very end.

1711969.title: Uncle
1711969.overview: When a man, quietly lost, suddenly finds himself caring for his best mate’s three-year-old son, a week of wandering, play and unexpected connection begins to unsettle the heaviness he carries.

1712289.title: The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End
1712289.overview: Caffeine-deprived Cand Caff’s day goes from bad to apocalyptic when his sentient fridge threatens to blow up the entire neighborhood unless he delivers a fresh energy drink — fast. What follows is a chaotic sprint filled with push-up battles, Karen attacks, and unhinged inner demons in this pitch-black, low-budget comedy.  The Energized Fridge 3: The Beginning of the End cranks the absurdity, self-loathing, and dark humor to eleven while somehow feeling like the start of something much bigger.

1712481.title: Interlude
1712481.overview: Following a failed suicide attempt, Clara is in a coma and discovers that the afterlife is a giant Scrabble tournament. It all makes no sense, and yet, she must win the competition to overcome her demons.

1714529.title: 40 Wacks
1714529.overview: When a group of friends wander into a long abandoned home they soon discover that a evil spirit is among them.

1714785.title: OnlyFans: Inside the Machine
1714785.overview: Amber Haque reveals how OnlyFans models suffer widespread exploitation and coercion at the hands of their managers.

1716385.title: Orange Chicken Night
1716385.overview: With only three chances to accept an incoming job offer, student worker Jud Beckett is forced to juggle a tyrannical manager and the chaos of dinner rush when the call he's been waiting for arrives at the worst possible time.

1716513.title: Extreme Makeover: Homer Edition
1716513.overview: Homer and Marge's fun couples' date night goes off the rails when Marge learns Homer left the kids unsupervised with only the doorbell camera as a babysitter. Frustrated with her imperfect husband, a tipsy Marge stirs up a trilogy of fantasies of a different Homer.

1716961.title: Getting to know you again and again

1717537.title: Fish Fear Me
1717537.overview: A very, very hungry fish eats anything he finds floating in the ocean, even the yucky stuff that should not be eaten. After gobbling up bits of plastic and trash, he gets a terrible tummy ache and learns an important lesson about putting the wrong things in your body.

1717793.title: Funny Thing About Love
1717793.overview: The Funny Thing About Love is a sexy, emotional Black romance dramedy set at Atlanta’s premier fictional HBCU, Hunter College.  When bestselling author Miles Morris returns home for his ten-year reunion, he is forced to face Alice Lewis, the brilliant former love who broke his heart. But Alice’s perfect life has fallen apart. Her marriage to NFL star Derick Pennington has collapsed, and she has moved back home under the watchful eye of her powerful father, Judge Charles Lewis.  Days before the reunion, Miles releases a tell-all book inspired by their college romance, sending shockwaves through campus and online. As old feelings resurface, Alice must confront a buried secret that could change everything, including the truth about a child Miles never knew existed.  Romantic, messy, tender, and explosively funny, The Funny Thing About Love is a modern Black love story about heartbreak, healing, second chances, and the secrets that shape us.
1717793.trailerName: Funny Thing About Love | Official Trailer | ALLBLK

1723489.title: Broken Harmony
1723489.overview: Recording artist Harmony Brown, listens to every suggestion from her record label including changing her sound, changing her look, and even changing the type of music she sang. Yet, her numbers aren't improving, and she's on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she's forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

1724065.title: 20001 An Earth Odyssey
1724065.overview: In the year 20001, three aliens arrive on the ruins of Earth to investigate the extinct human race. Revering humanity as a highly intelligent civilization, they wildly misinterpret the artifacts left behind: mistaking playgrounds for sacred places, umbrellas for communication devices, and graveyards for farmland.  The team consists of a warm-hearted yet misguided captain, a highly logical but often inaccurate analyst, and their innocent, instinctive young member. While the two adults obsessively analyze human civilization through logic and theory, the  youngest slowly begins to understand humanity through emotion, contradiction, and empathy, discovering that what science cannot decode, the heart just might.

1724385.title: La Retirada ou l'exode d'un peuple

1725345.title: The Boy
1725345.overview: A transgender woman searches a Cornish coastal town for a lost boy but quickly finds herself in a race against the Law.

1727329.title: The Romantic Nebula
1727329.overview: In a country dominated by repressive police and institutional powers, The Nebula operates clandestinely at night. To strengthen the Resistance, it reconstructs and revives corpses. Two members embark on a mission to break this cycle of violence.

1727521.title: Echoes
1727521.overview: The lives of two men unexpectedly intersect as they confront the lasting impact of their boarding school past, and as buried memories resurface.

1728033.title: Threshold
1728033.overview: The mind builds the Dehleej, but the heart crosses it.

1728801.title: A Sweet Day
1728801.overview: When a young woman gets the chance to have a conjugal meeting with her imprisoned husband after a long time,  ​she decides to re-experience a romantic time in the apathetic and harsh atmosphere of the prison.

1728993.title: In On The Joke
1728993.overview: Four friends challenge each other to a surreal competition consisting in devising elaborate pranks to play on one another, until yet another prank takes a horrific turn.

1729185.title: Sea of Glass
1729185.overview: 65-year-old Vangelio decides to go on holiday after her husband's death. In a run-down off-season seaside resort she meets Vicky, a young woman caring for her alcoholic father. When Vangelio protects Vicky from her father's violence, chaos erupts in their seaside town.

1729953.title: Ravel: Piano Concerto for the Left Hand Anna Vinnitskaya in Strasbourg
1729953.overview: The Strasbourg Philharmonic Orchestra, conducted by Aziz Shokhakimov invites Anna Vinnitskaya, who won first prize at the Queen Elisabeth Competition in 2007, to perform Maurice Ravel’s Piano Concerto for the Left Hand. Ravel composed this virtuoso jazz-influenced work for pianist Paul Wittgenstein, who had lost his right arm in the First World War. Part of europiano, ARTE's special day celebrating the piano concerto across Europe

1730721.title: Dean
1730721.overview: Jack moves into a share house. Things quickly spiral.

1731745.title: Sidetracked
1731745.overview: A hopeful party goer tries to get to the function, but is inundated with various requests and errands of increasing absurdity.

1732193.title: Good Mourning
1732193.overview: Two siblings explore whether it is possible to reconnect when the past still lingers.

1733089.title: La Finale - Italia Francia 2006 - Il cielo è azzurro sopra Berlino
1733089.overview: On July 9, 2006, Zidane’s headbutt on Materazzi turned the World Cup final into a legend—a symbol of the rivalry between France and Italy. Twenty years after Berlin, the key figures and commentators look back on that iconic match.

1734241.title: Nós-Irreversível
1734241.overview: Fernando and Camila shared a bond that time could not erase. Years later, a chance encounter turns into a possible reckoning.

1736801.title: The Terrible Power of Fiction
1736801.overview: María Finojosa, wife of Spanish settler Juan de Cervantes, tunes into the fragile memory of the exact moment when her husband became obsessed with founding a town that would perpetuate his family name. In the middle of the 19th century, in the mountains of Costa Rica, María's memory of her husband's Quixote-like delusions, unravels like the reel of an old film, projected onto the persistent rain and the constant lurking of the cracks of fiction.

1736993.title: Thera: The Inverted Planet
1736993.overview: On another world much like our own, a young Samoyed named Seamus Alessandro O'Shaughnessy discovers a lost girl named Dakota who has unfathomable magic! Seamus must overcome great challenges both physical & emotional alongside his best friend Carolina Oriqueda Campbell Keeshond-Seal to save Great Canyon City from the Menace known as The Blurred Blaze! Can our heroes defeat their foes while simultaneously protecting an innocent child in the process? And who exactly is The Blurred Blaze?
1736993.trailerName: First Storyboard Test for “Thera: The Inverted Planet”

1738209.title: Liebe braucht Meer
1738209.overview: Lissi Strack, a young lawyer, travels with her mother Silvia, the owner of an internationally renowned law firm specializing in insolvency, to the Breton port city of Cancale. When Silvia has a mishap during the trip and is hit by a car driven by the young Alain Demur, she has no choice but to return home. This gives Lissi the chance to step in for Silvia, find an investor on her own, and finally prove herself to her mother.

1738401.title: A Few of Shakespeare's Days of Despair
1738401.overview: Unable to write for a long time, William Shakespeare embarks on a desperate search for inspiration. But everything he encounters forces him to confront his own legacy and creative burnout.

1739297.title: Rival Wife
1739297.overview: Rival Wife is a 2026 burmese horror-drama movie directed by Wyne

1740257.title: NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY  SEOUL - THE REDLINE’ in CINEMAS
1740257.overview: Back after almost two years, NCT 127's fifth tour,  NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY : SEOUL - THE REDLINE’, is coming live to cinemas!  Experience the explosive energy, world-class performances, and electrifying atmosphere of KSPO DOME brought to life on the big screen with immersive sound.  NCTzens, join us for the spectacular kickoff of 'THE REDLINE'!

1741857.title: Infernus
1741857.overview: a couple escapes to a seaside hotel to salvage their failing relationship but what they uncover within themselves is far darker than any mysteries at the hotel they are stuck at.

1745569.title: Miso Soup
1745569.overview: College student Reiko enrolls in a Japanese-language class to learn her heritage language. However, she begins to fall behind and feels like she is not Japanese enough. In turn, Reiko has to navigate her own feelings about having a dual identity.

1745761.title: Termite
1745761.overview: Shaunak Sen’s follow-up to the Academy Award–nominated documentary All That Breathes is an evocative drama set in the vibrant neighbourhoods of Old Delhi, where the routined lives of two middle-aged termite exterminators are about to drastically change when one of them receives an unexpected marriage proposal.

1746465.title: Plötzlich Schwiegervater
1746465.overview: Paul Hagedorn’s beloved daughter, Annette, wants to get married. But from the very first moment, Hagedorn and his future son-in-law, Joe, can’t stand each other. Their first meeting ends in a physical altercation that leads to legal consequences. What begins as a personal conflict quickly escalates into a bitter power struggle between the two men, leaving Annette caught in the middle…

1748513.title: Confession or: Bondary Project
1748513.overview: a boy looks back on the story of his old memories and relationship that buried in the past.

1748641.title: Дороги судоку
1748641.overview: One morning, Yana discovers that her domineering grandmother has transferred money to scammers and a colleague has framed her in front of her boss. To make matters worse, her grandmother continues to trust the scammers more than her own granddaughter. In a single day, Yana must find a way to save her job and her sense of self without destroying her relationship with her grandmother.

1752801.title: Agbogbloshie
1752801.overview: The world replaced six thousand phones this morning. All of them are burning in Agbogbloshie, in the heart of Accra, where six thousand people make a living stripping copper from what you replaced. They breathe air five times more polluted than what the WHO considers safe. No one keeps track of what they die from. He lives there. And while everyone else scavenges for weight, he searches for the part that still works. With a washing machine motor, laptop batteries, and spliced wires, he raises a streetlight in the middle of the alley where he lives. That night, for the first time in twenty-two years, the street had light. That's why they found him. Fiction set in a place that exists.

1760097.title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 10
1760097.overview: The tenth night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 22, 2026, at Yotsuba Arena Tokachi in Obihiro, Hokkaido, Japan.

1762529.title: The Unrehearsed
1762529.overview: An actress prepping for a career defining audition starts to spiral as performance, identity, and reality begin to blur.

1764193.title: Echo Point
1764193.overview: A man inherits a secluded cabin from his estranged father. Inside, he discovers an old radio emitting strange, eerie signals. As he begins to unravel the truth, he realises the voices on the other end belong to the victims of a killer.
1764193.trailerName: Official Horror Movie Trailer | Echo Point (2026)
